shell.leaveConfirm.title: Leave iCompress?
shell.leaveConfirm.body: Going back will leave the app.
processing.leaveConfirm.title: Leave without downloading?
processing.leaveConfirm.body: Your compressed results haven't been downloaded yet and will be discarded.
processing.cancel.label: Cancel
processing.download.assemblyFailed: The download file couldn't be assembled, so nothing was saved and no partial file was kept. Press Download to try again.
processing.download.blocked: Your browser blocked the download. Allow downloads from this site, then press Download again.
processing.share.failed: Sharing didn't finish, so nothing left your device. Press Share to try again, or download instead.
processing.failure.heading: Failed
processing.failure.decode: Could not be read. The file may be damaged, or not the kind of image its name suggests.
processing.failure.encode: Could not be compressed at these settings.
processing.failure.memory: Too large for this browser to compress. Try a smaller image — the desktop application has no such limit.
processing.skip.heading: Skipped
gallery.emptyState.headline: Drop images to compress
gallery.emptyState.formats: JPEG · PNG · WEBP · AVIF · GIF · HEIC
gallery.affordance: Click an image to preview the result, rotate or crop it
panel.dimension.helpFitLongEdgeLabel: What does Fit within long edge do?
panel.dimension.helpFitLongEdgeBody: Fits the image's longer side to the value you choose.
panel.dimension.helpFixedWidthBody: Sets an exact width. Height adjusts to match.
panel.dimension.helpFixedHeightBody: Sets an exact height. Width adjusts to match.
panel.dimension.noteMultiCropped: Crop applied to {count} images. Their crop overrides the setting below; the rest follow it.
panel.dimension.noteSingleCropped: This image is cropped — the crop sets its output size, so dimension options are off.
panel.format.gifWarning: GIF produces worse results than JPEG for photographs.
preview.frame.originalUnavailable: Your browser can't display {filename} as it is — the desktop application can. The Compressed tab still shows the real result.
preview.error.decode: {filename} could not be read. The file may be damaged, or not the kind of image its name suggests.
preview.error.encode: {filename} could not be compressed at these settings. Try a different format or quality.
preview.error.memory: {filename} is too large for this browser to compress. Try a smaller image — the desktop application has no such limit.
preview.error.unsupported: {filename} can't be written as {format} in this build yet. Pick a different output format.
preview.error.sourceMissing: {filename} is no longer available to read. Remove it and add it again.
preview.transform.flatten: {format} has no transparency — transparent areas will be filled.
preview.transform.animationSubstituted: Animated source — written as animated WebP, because the chosen format cannot animate.
preview.transform.originalKeptTarget: Original kept — it already meets the size target.
preview.transform.originalKeptNotSmaller: Original kept — re-encoding was not smaller.
preview.toolbar.editAnimatedReason: Rotating and cropping aren't available for animated images in this version.
preview.error.animatedAvif: {filename} is an animated AVIF, which this app cannot compress. Remove it and use a different file.
preview.size.unreachable: Couldn’t reach {target} as {width}×{height} {format}. Smallest possible at these settings: {achieved}. This image will be skipped.
preview.size.batch: The size setting applies to all {count} images.
preview.size.noAlternative: No verified automatic alternative was found.
preview.size.animationNoRecovery: Automatic alternatives aren’t checked for animated images. This image will be skipped.
edit.background.heading: Background
edit.background.jpegHint: JPEG has no transparency — pick a fill colour.
rejection.heading: Some files weren't added
rejection.reason.psd: {name}: Photoshop (PSD) files aren't supported. Export it as JPEG or PNG first.
rejection.reason.ico: {name}: icon (ICO) files aren't supported. Choose a different file.
rejection.reason.svg: {name}: SVG files aren't supported. Choose a different file.
rejection.reason.cameraRaw: {name}: camera raw files aren't supported. Export or convert it to JPEG or PNG first.
rejection.reason.animatedAvif: {name}: animated AVIF isn't supported. Convert it to WebP or GIF, or choose a still image.
rejection.reason.heicUnavailable: {name}: this browser can't decode HEIC. Try a different browser, or use the desktop application, which has no such limit.
rejection.reason.fileTooLarge: {name} is {actual}, over the {cap} limit for this browser. Try a smaller image, or use the desktop application, which has no such limit.
rejection.reason.batchCountExceeded: This selection has {actual} images, over the {cap}-image limit per batch. Select fewer images, or process them in smaller groups.
rejection.reason.folderEmpty: This folder didn't contain any images this app can process.
rejection.reason.folderDepthExceeded: This folder is nested {actual} levels deep, over the {cap}-level limit. Flatten it or choose a shallower folder.
rejection.reason.folderFileCountExceeded: This folder contains {actual} files, over the {cap}-file limit. Choose a smaller folder.
processing.total.allFailedOrSkipped: Nothing to download — see Failed/Skipped below.
processing.halted.memory: This batch is too large for this browser to compress. Try fewer or smaller images — the desktop application has no such limit.
processing.halted.storage: Storage stopped working partway through this batch, so the run was halted and no partial file was kept. Try again, or try fewer images.
processing.quota.rejected: This batch needs {required} of storage but only {available} is free. Free up space, or try fewer or smaller images.
site.seo.tool.title: Mass Image Compressor — Free, Open-Source Image Compression
site.seo.tool.description: Free, open-source online tool to compress, resize and convert JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and GIF images. Nothing is uploaded — processing happens on your device.
site.seo.faq.title: FAQ — Mass Image Compressor
site.seo.faq.description: Answers about supported formats, privacy, batch limits, and how compression, resizing and cropping work in Mass Image Compressor.
site.seo.privacy.title: Privacy — Mass Image Compressor
site.seo.privacy.description: How Mass Image Compressor handles your images: processing happens on your device, and nothing leaves it unless you choose to share a result.
site.seo.terms.title: Terms of Service — Mass Image Compressor
site.seo.terms.description: The terms covering use of the Mass Image Compressor web app.
site.seo.desktop.title: Desktop Version — Mass Image Compressor
site.seo.desktop.description: A separate desktop application for processing very large batches or files without any browser limits.
gallery.emptyState.privacy: Your images are compressed on this device and are never uploaded — a finished result leaves only if you press Share and choose where it goes.
gallery.emptyState.privacyAnalytics: The site itself counts anonymous visits through a cookie-free analytics service, and sends nothing about you, your files or what you did with them.
